note: Fictional support messages written for the demo, with the expected label for each.

tickets.text: Our checkout has been failing in production since this morning's release and customers cannot pay. We need someone to help us find the regression today.
Our customer-support chatbot told several users they could get a full refund after 90 days, which is not our policy. Legal wants it evaluated before Friday.
Hi, I'm switching careers into software testing. Do you have a course or mentoring I could start next month?
The revenue numbers in our Power BI dashboard don't match the finance system. Could you review our data pipeline in the next few weeks?
We're a small startup and need an MVP of a booking web app with an API. What would the process look like?
I think invoice 2026-114 was charged twice to our card. Can you check and refund the duplicate?
We'd like to set up automated regression tests for our app sometime this year. No rush, just exploring options.
Our RAG assistant is exposing other customers' account details in its answers right now. We've disabled it but need an urgent investigation.
Notre application mobile plante à l'ouverture chez la moitié des utilisateurs Android depuis la mise à jour d'hier. Pouvez-vous nous aider à tester rapidement ?
Nous aimerions un atelier d'une journée sur l'automatisation des tests pour notre équipe de cinq testeurs, le mois prochain.
Les chargements de données de la nuit échouent depuis trois jours et les rapports de la direction sont vides. C'est bloquant pour le comité de lundi.
Hello! Are you hiring QA engineers at the moment? I'd love to send my resume.
